lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 4 — Peter and John Before the Sanhedrin

questions.questionText: Who came up to Peter and John while they were speaking to the people?
options: The priests, the captain of the temple guard, and the Sadducees

questions.questionText: Why were the leaders greatly disturbed?
options: The apostles taught and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection of the dead

questions.questionText: What did they do to Peter and John because it was evening?
options: They put them in jail until the next day

questions.questionText: About how many men believed after hearing the message?
Where did the rulers, elders and teachers of the law meet the next day?
I was the high priest present with Caiaphas, John and Alexander. Who am I?
Who asked Peter and John, “By what power or what name did you do this?”
options: The rulers who brought them in

questions.questionText: Who was filled with the Holy Spirit and answered the rulers?
Peter said they were being called to account for what kind of act?
options: An act of kindness shown to a lame man

questions.questionText: Peter said the lame man was healed by the name of _____ Christ of Nazareth.
What stone did Peter say the builders rejected?
Peter said, “Salvation is found in _____ else.”
What did the leaders realize about Peter and John?
options: They were unschooled, ordinary men who had been with Jesus

questions.questionText: Who was standing there with Peter and John as living proof of the healing?
options: The man who had been healed

questions.questionText: What did the leaders command Peter and John not to do?
options: Speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus

questions.questionText: Who said, “Which is right in God’s eyes: to listen to you, or to him?”
They said, “We cannot help speaking about what we have _____ and heard.”
Why did the leaders let them go?
options: They were afraid of the people, because all the people were praising God

questions.questionText: How old was the man who had been healed?
Where did Peter and John go after they were released?
When the believers heard the report, what did they do?
options: They raised their voices together in prayer to God
They packed to leave the city

questions.questionText: In their prayer they quoted who saying the nations rage?
options: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of your servant, our father David

questions.questionText: Which rulers did they say gathered against Jesus?
What did the believers ask God to enable them to do?
options: Speak your word with great boldness

questions.questionText: What happened after they prayed?
options: The place where they were meeting was shaken

questions.questionText: What did they do after the place was shaken?
options: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly

questions.questionText: True or false: All the believers were one in heart and mind.
What did no one claim about their possessions?
options: That any of their possessions was their own

questions.questionText: With great power, who continued to testify to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus?
True or false: There were no needy persons among them.
options: False — only the rich were helped
False — they kept all money secret

questions.questionText: What did people who owned land or houses do?
options: They sold them and brought the money

questions.questionText: Where did they put the money?
options: In the temple tax box only

questions.questionText: I was a Levite from Cyprus called Joseph, but the apostles called me Barnabas. Who am I?
What does the name Barnabas mean?
Where was Barnabas from?
What did Barnabas do with a field he owned?
options: He sold it and brought the money to the apostles’ feet

questions.questionText: I am a Levite and I sold a field to help the believers. Who am I?
The council commanded Peter and John not to speak in Jesus’ name. Who answered them?
Where were Peter and John speaking when they were seized?
options: To the people (after the temple healing)

questions.questionText: True or false: The leaders found a way to punish Peter and John without fearing the people.
options: False — they could not decide how to punish them and let them go
True — they sent them to Caesar
False — they never talked to them

questions.questionText: I am the captain who came with the priests and Sadducees. What group did I lead?
Peter said there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be what?
